name: Kettlebell Walter Catch
description: A soft two-handed catch that closes the flow, coming off the skier swing: as the bell floats up, receive it at chest height and cradle it with BOTH hands — one hand on the handle, the other cupping the ball (the round body) up near the sternum. Absorb the momentum with soft arms and a braced core rather than snatching it stiff-armed; the skill is quiet hands and a controlled deceleration, not the load. Go light — it's a hand-eye / coordination beat.
